verses.text: “Hey, everybody who's thirsty, come to the water! Even if you haven't got money, come buy and eat! Come get wine and milk. You don't need money. It costs you nothing.
Why spend money on stuff that isn't food or work for things that leave you empty? Listen closely to me and eat what's good. Let your soul enjoy the rich food.
Lean in and come to me. Listen and you'll live. I'll make a covenant with you that lasts forever, with the faithful love I promised David.
Look, I made him a witness for the peoples, a leader and commander over them.
Look, you'll call a nation you don't know, and a nation that didn't know you will run to you because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel. He's given you glory.”
Look for the LORD while you can find him. Call out while he's close.

Let people who do evil leave their road behind and those who do wrong give up their thoughts. Let them come back to the LORD. He'll show them mercy. Come back to our God, because he'll forgive freely.
“My thoughts aren't your thoughts, and your ways aren't my ways,” says the LORD.
“Just as the heavens are high above the earth, my ways are higher than your ways and my thoughts higher than yours.
Rain and snow come down from the sky. They don't go back up before watering the earth, making things grow and sprout, giving seed to the planter and bread to the one who eats.
That's what my word is like when it leaves my mouth. It won't come back empty. It'll do what I want and succeed at what I sent it to do.
You'll go out with joy and be led along in peace. Mountains and hills will burst into song in front of you, and every tree in the field will clap its hands.
Cypress trees will rise where thorns grew. Myrtle will grow where briers were. It'll bring honor to the LORD's name, a sign that lasts forever and won't be cut off.”
